lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the vertical gill slits, exhibiting a periodic spatial distribution in at least five identifiable vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity pixel bands intersecting with longitudinal axes, where high-luminance blobs serve as nodes at the intersection points, creating a coordinate-like array.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear discontinuity in luminance on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient indicating a structural ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse, non-uniform distribution of high-luminance blobs bounded within the first dorsal fin's perimeter, primarily concentrated in the lower and central regions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Rectangular yellow-toned feature with high-contrast edges located on the dorsal midline posterior to the head, distinct from the surrounding biological texture.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated dark pixel clusters with distinct silhouettes positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin and along the lower flank, exhibiting independent orientations.
